name: Bot Deck
description: A team of bots inside Orca. Runs the open-source OpenMausBot on your machine: a roster of bots, each its own Claude, Codex or Grok agent. Unofficial; not affiliated with OpenMausBot or its engines.

commands.title: Bot Deck: Stop the OpenMausBot server

settings.title: Give Claude bots my Claude tools
settings.description: Claude bots use the connectors, MCP servers, skills and instructions from your Claude setup. More tools means more tokens per message. Turn off to give Claude bots only what you add in OpenMausBot.

settings.title: Let my Orca agents talk to the bots
settings.description: Adds Bot Deck's tools to Claude and Codex on this computer. Turn off to remove them.
